provenance: Test counts, macro compiler verification and concise outcome are read from completed GitHub job logs. Full distributions and raw samples are read from their artifacts. Summary arithmetic was independently recomputed from raw JSON using only local standard-library parsing; no project code was executed locally.

methodology.noise_control: baseline-repeat uses the identical baseline binary, checked by core SHA.
methodology.decision_statistic: Median of all six paired process-median ratios, with the entire distribution and same-code noise retained; never the fastest sample.

interpretation.Linux: The actual 100-step-chunk phase is effectively unchanged in this run. Single-step 10x10 and 32x32 kernels regress; long 10x10 kernels show no net gain.
interpretation.macOS: The actual-phase difference overlaps same-code noise. Kernel paired medians regress in all measured cases, including the production-sized 10x10 grid.
interpretation.Windows: The actual-phase paired median is 1.0231x, but two of six blocks are slower and the same-code noise has wide outliers. 100-step 10x10 kernels improve modestly while single-step kernels regress.
interpretation.default_policy: This evidence file changes no production defaults. It does not support universally enabling the neighbor table; root will decide any platform/step-specific policy from the measured tradeoffs.

limits: Hosted CPU measurements, not a physical user-M1 or Hyper-V deployment benchmark.
Kernel timings include direct ctypes/Python call-loop overhead, per-call table construction and C++ copying/arithmetic/RNG; no fastest-sample selection.
Actual phase includes initialization, real headless <=100-step segmentation, Python/native movement and final legacy reduction; excludes imports/setup/warm-up/hash/close.
Kernel records hash every activity/stability/MT byte. Actual phase checks full legacy and Python/NumPy/Torch RNG plus generation, but its API does not expose final grid arrays.
Memory table sizes are layout estimates, not measured RSS.
No local project imports/builds/tests/simulation/training/benchmarks, Docker installation or extra workflow dispatch/rerun were performed by this evidence task.

artifact.digest_provenance: GitHub Actions artifact metadata; archive ZIP was not separately rehashed after gh extracted its JSON.

summary.memory_note: Estimated NeighborRow storage only, not measured memory/RSS; excludes vector/allocator overhead.
summary.scope: One hosted CPU runner, sequential fresh processes, all six configuration permutations per cycle. Baseline-repeat uses the identical baseline binary. Headline ratios use every paired block median; raw per-sample timings/digests are retained. Kernel timing includes per-call table construction and ctypes boundary/loop overhead; inputs/outputs are preallocated. Actual phase uses the same harness for both source roots, grid10 x 10000 generations, CPU1, no LLM/display/log/keyboard/exports, with headless <=100-step segments. It includes initialization, Python/native movement and final legacy reduction; excludes imports, simulation setup, warm-up, final state hashing and close. Actual phase checks complete legacy, Python/NumPy/Torch RNG and generation, but exposes no final cell arrays; kernel cases independently hash every activity/stability/MT byte. Not full-world or local-M1 proof.
summary.decision_note: Exact results are required, not sufficient for adoption. Compare candidate paired distributions with same-code noise, especially actual 100-step chunks and single-step regressions. Macro activation must be proven separately by workflow compiler logs; no fastest-sample selection.
